signature: "MACHT FRIEDRICH // EHE = IN = NURNB", engraved tulip and master's mark: "F (star) E)". [****check Worthmuller and Herbert. Is it M.F. Ehe?]
mouthpiece: : Relatively deep bowl, ca. 1800; inner diameter of cup 18, outer diameter 26.1, depth of cup 13.2, throat 3.9, total length 96.
dimensions: bo 10.2, be 106, le 2015, h 845²,  bell section entry 13.5.
literature: : Wörthmüller 1955:416; Langwill 1974:45; *Van der Meer 1979: 90-91, Abb. 139 (photo); Young 1980:104 (photo); Van der Meer 1982:50; Huber 1989:354.
remarks: Tubular slide stays with leaf pattern on dotted background. One flat bell stay with tulip and five-petal flower and tendrils; eyelet toward bell-stay side. Rings in slide- and bell-bows, mounted on plates decorated with zigzag pattern. Ferrules have ring pattern.
